title: Family planning demand satisfied (modern methods), LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS compared with the World
custodian: UN DESA Population Division and UNFPA
headline: Data on demand met with modern methods cover 43 of 44 LDCs, 32 of 32 LLDCs and 27 of 39 SIDS
subtitle: Demand for family planning satisfied with modern methods - percentage of women (aged 15-49 years)
years: Countries with any value; for 61 of the 79 with data, the latest is from 2020 or earlier.
data_line: Data: UN DESA Population Division and UNFPA via UN SDG Global Database, series SH_FPL_MTMM, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Data on demand met with modern methods cover 43 of 44 LDCs, 32 of 32 LLDCs and 27 of 39 SIDS. Countries with any value; for 61 of the 79 with data, the latest is from 2020 or earlier. LLDCs: 32 of 32 countries with data; LDCs: 43 of 44 countries with data; SIDS: 27 of 39 countries with data
method: Method: latest value per country; 2020 or earlier is not recent.
question: Which countries have found a way to measure demand met with modern methods more often, and what made it possible?
